thread:
lina: Quick post-all-hands thread for anyone with follow-ups on pricing, packaging, and usage policy. Drop short Qs here and we'll route.
sam: Two quick ones: 1) trial credits expiry policy? 2) can credits be applied to marketplace purchases?
julia: Legal/finance: default trial credits expire 12 months after issuance unless promo states otherwise; non-transferable. Marketplace purchases are billed separately by default; promos can opt to include them. We'll update FAQ language.
maya: Rate limit detail: is there a distinct per-minute burst cap aside from per-second soft limits? Customers want clear limits to plan autoscaling.
ethan: Hosted defaults are soft at ~10 rps per project (600 rpm) with a short queuing/grace window before 429s. We surface `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers.
ops-bot: note: canary: header rollout in us-central-1.
lina: Ops, is per-org grace configurable? Some customers want strict 429s to avoid queued spikes.
ops-bot: ticket ORG-812 created for per-org throttle-grace configuration.
tim: (added in thread) Dedicated customers can negotiate a prepaid burst pool as an add-on; billing differs from committed capacity depending on the contract. No universal hard cap 

bursts limited by available region capacity.
maya: DevEx: can we get a one-pager with recommended thresholds and cURL examples showing the headers and exponential backoff? Sales/CSM need that.
devex: Yup. I'll draft a one-page playbook: sample cURL, header parsing snippet, decision tree (when to suggest Dedicated/Optimize). Draft by end of week.
sam: Last bit: if a customer hits soft throttle and gets queued requests, do we surface queue position or ETA?
ethan: We don't surface position yet; we expose reset/remaining. Team backlog item to explore queue ETA in headers.
lina: Great, I'll compile these notes into the all-hands follow-up doc and post in #docs. If any other asks, add them here and tag me. Thanks all!
